correctness.rationale: The letter-action recurrence is exact. The parity relation z=(x-1)y mod 2 follows by summing i(x-i) across ones; explicit commutator words generate all and only allowable triples. Suffix decomposition z+ay+bx+d classifies right quotients; three feasible parity pairs versus one give the exact exceptional fourfold congruence. Complete finite DFA minimization on moduli 2..14 and exhaustive independent index-triple counting on 4095 words corroborate the proof. The infinite conclusion is proved symbolically.

value.rationale: A natural single-pattern modular-language complexity problem is completely resolved for all integer moduli and target residues, including an exact factor-four quotient phenomenon at modulus multiples of four with odd targets. This is a qualitative structural threshold, not a small finite gain or routine bound; the statement and its exact quotient classes are useful for reasoning about state complexity of modular subsequence counters.
